AIR Akashvani Ext.Service FAQ

What frequency is AIR Akashvani Ext.Service on?
In the B-26 season AIR Akashvani Ext.Service is scheduled on 10 shortwave frequencies, including 9795, 9870, 11710, 11750, 11865, 11900 kHz. Best evening option for eastern North America: 11710 kHz (9 pm – 9:15 pm Eastern). For Europe: 11900 kHz (9 pm – 9:15 pm UTC+1).

What time is AIR Akashvani Ext.Service on shortwave?
AIR Akashvani Ext.Service is scheduled in 36 UTC time windows this season, from 00:45–01:00 UTC through 23:45–01:15 UTC. English broadcasts: 14:00–14:15 UTC; 02:00–02:15 UTC; 13:40–13:55 UTC; 11:55–12:10 UTC. All times are UTC; subtract your UTC offset for local time.

Can I hear AIR Akashvani Ext.Service in the USA?
It isn't beamed at North America this season, so hearing it in the USA is a DX catch. Your best chance is 11710 kHz (9 pm – 9:15 pm Eastern) when that band is open, or listen through an online receiver (KiwiSDR/WebSDR) closer to its target area.

Does AIR Akashvani Ext.Service broadcast in English on shortwave?
Yes. English broadcasts this season: 9870 kHz at 14:00–14:15 UTC to Afghanistan; 11710 kHz at 02:00–02:15 UTC to Tib; 11750 kHz at 13:40–13:55 UTC to Afghanistan; 11865 kHz at 11:55–12:10 UTC to Tib; 11900 kHz at 16:35–16:50 UTC to Iran; plus 9 more.

Is AIR Akashvani Ext.Service on the air right now?
As of Monday, November 9, 2026, 13:53 UTC, AIR Akashvani Ext.Service is scheduled to be broadcasting on 9870 kHz to Afghanistan. This is based on the published schedule at the time this page was built; check the live search for up-to-the-minute status.
